cause.summary: Implementation Readiness initializes visited_units as an empty list and its selection-ready reducer selects captured_frontier[len(visited_units)]. It does not consume the completed-prefix continuity evidenced by the six immutable ONT receipts.

alternativeChecked.description: A temporary current-only frontier containing TS001 was audited without mutating repository sources.
alternativeChecked.reason: ONT006 must remain in the captured frontier because TS001 depends on it.

requiredRepair.behavior: Seed or reconcile an immutable completed frontier prefix from validated continuity evidence before automatic next-unit selection, while failing closed on gaps, forks, digest drift, or non-prefix completion.
acceptance: A seven-unit APE frontier with ONT001 through ONT006 completed selects TS001 as the next unit.
A missing, reordered, digest-drifted, or non-prefix completion receipt blocks before selection.
A fresh Work Pack with no completed receipts still selects its first unit.
No product choice, promotion, or authority effect is inferred from continuity.
